cards.power: The Pink Slip. One night, one match. If you bore me, you're buried permanently.
cards.lore: THE HEEL PROMOTER: He thinks the roster is disposable. He's wrong. Power: 100. Style: pulp ink. Subject: horned bull-king in robes wielding axe. Mood: tyrant-boss.

cards.power: The Promo. My words are a crossbody into your heart. I've got a thousand nights of heat in the tank.
cards.lore: TOP FACE BOOKER: She's turning the shoot into a work to save the locker room. Power: 99. Style: watercolor pulp. Subject: fox-storyteller mid-mic-drop on starlit stage. Mood: spellbinding.

cards.power: Ringside Distraction. Sister, tell him the one about the apples! We aren't tapping out tonight!
cards.lore: THE VALET: She keeps the heat alive when the main event drags. Power: 90. Style: ink-wash. Subject: bull and weasel ringside, shouting cues. Mood: pep-rally chaos.

cards.power: The Reluctant Three-Count. I'm just following orders. Please... just one more night for the kid?
cards.lore: THE MANAGER TURNED REFEREE: Caught between the Bull and the Fox. Power: 50. Style: pulp ink. Subject: owl in ref shirt wringing hands. Mood: compromised authority.

cards.power: The Push. Gains +10 Power for every 'Treasure' card in play.
cards.lore: Formerly working dark matches in a cave. Now in the Main Event. Power: 20 (+80 w/ Lamp). Style: watercolor pulp. Subject: monkey-rookie wrestler with championship-belt aura. Mood: underdog ascent.

cards.power: Gimmick Infringement. Can steal an Artifact card from any Face character.
cards.lore: THE HEEL MANAGER who scouted the talent, only to get screwed out of the commission. Power: 75. Style: dark ink. Subject: cloaked ape with contract scroll. Mood: predatory bureaucrat.

cards.power: Cosmic Heat. Summons a Genie Token (95 Power). Three wishes, No DQ.
cards.lore: Sentient brass. The ultimate Foreign Object. Power: INF. Style: gold-leaf ink. Subject: glowing lamp on velvet. Mood: power-object.

cards.power: The Valet's Gambit. Protects Aladdin from Manager effects for 3 turns.
cards.lore: She doesn't want the Vizier's son; she wants the guy with the blue giant in his corner. Power: 50. Style: ornate pulp. Subject: peacock-princess on throne. Mood: regal switch-up.

cards.power: The High Flyer. Immune to 'Ring Out' effects. Master of Selling.
cards.lore: Seven voyages, seven stipulations. He bumps like a maniac but always kicks out at two. Power: 60. Style: weathered pulp. Subject: pelican wrestler mid-leap from turnbuckle. Mood: showman daredevil.

cards.power: Ring Collapse. The ring just dried. Good luck selling this to the crowd.
cards.lore: A sentient arena that No-Sells the fire. Power: 85. Style: ink-and-wash. Subject: whale with masts on its back as island. Mood: kayfabe geology.

cards.power: Ladder Match Hazard. Takes you to the clouds; no landing pad below.
cards.lore: The ultimate vertical suplex machine. Power: 92. Style: bold ink. Subject: griffin-eagle clutching ladder mid-flight. Mood: aerial doom.

cards.power: Razor Terrain. All characters take 10 damage per turn.
cards.lore: High risk, high reward. The floor is literally knives. Power: N/A (Field). Style: jagged ink. Subject: glittering snake-infested ravine. Mood: hostile glamour.

cards.power: The Squash Match. Instantly destroys the lowest power character card.
cards.lore: A cannibal Heel. He likes his Jobbers well-done. Power: 95. Style: brutal ink. Subject: tusked boar-giant with club. Mood: monster-heel.

cards.cardName: THE OLD MAN OF THE SEA
cards.power: Infinite Chokehold. Attaches to an opponent; they cannot attack until this card is removed.
cards.lore: The backpack you can't take off. Tap out or black out. Power: 70. Style: ink-wash. Subject: toad-grandpa coiled in vines on shoulders. Mood: parasitic doom.

cards.power: Dirty Finish. Forces the 'Old Man' card to detach/sleep.
cards.lore: A Foreign Object used to break the submission hold. Power: Item. Style: still-life ink. Subject: spilled green pumpkin-gourd with steam. Mood: tactical brew.

cards.power: Hard Reset. Destroys all equipped items in play.
cards.lore: The tour bus crashed. Everyone starts from zero. Power: Field. Style: turbulent ink. Subject: shattered ship timbers on shore. Mood: catastrophic clean-slate.

cards.power: The Opportunist. Draw 3 cards if 'Magic Cave' is in play.
cards.lore: A woodcutter who found the master script. He's taxing the gold and the push. Power: 30. Style: pulp ink. Subject: jackal-peasant peering past stone door. Mood: lucky thief.

cards.power: Hardcore Valet. Destroys 'Thief' tokens instantly.
cards.lore: She marked your coffins. The dance ends when the dagger hits. Power: 90. Style: dark ink. Subject: ferret-dancer twirling daggers. Mood: lethal grace.

cards.power: The Botch. Destroyed if you don't play a 'Password' card.
cards.lore: Forgot his lines. Trapped in the cage with forty monsters. Power: 10. Style: ink-wash. Subject: donkey-fool stuck behind boulder door. Mood: bumbling demise.

cards.power: Steel Cage. No one enters or leaves without the 'Voice Gimmick'.
cards.lore: The ultimate gated community. Power: Field. Style: heavy ink. Subject: roaring stone mouth as cave entrance. Mood: monstrous gate.

cards.power: Stable Leader. +5 Power for every Thief Token in play.
cards.lore: Not here for gold. Here for the Heat. Power: 40 (+40). Style: bold ink. Subject: snarling wolf-chieftain howling order. Mood: bandit-king.

cards.power: Zerg Rush. Overwhelms single target blockers.
cards.lore: Token swarm. Individually weak, collectively a burial squad. Power: Swarm. Style: chaotic ink. Subject: rat-thieves mob in motion. Mood: scurry-doom. Thirty-Nine

cards.power: Mind Games. Confuses the target; 50% chance attack hits wrong target.
cards.lore: They tried to mark the house. Morgiana marked the whole block. Power: Effect. Style: chalk-on-wood. Subject: white X on locked door. Mood: paranoia trap.

cards.power: Boiling Point. If attacked, destroys the attacker.
cards.lore: Hiding in the props department. A fatal mistake. Power: Trap. Style: still-life ink. Subject: clay jar with glowing eye inside. Mood: lurking ambush.

cards.power: Iron Script. Immune to Poison/Bleed. Cannot be persuaded.
cards.lore: The Tank Class. His contract is written in rust and cannot be rewritten. Power: 90. Style: bronze ink. Subject: clockwork lion with mane gears. Mood: incorruptible monarch.

cards.power: Programmed Ref. Forces players to reveal their hands.
cards.lore: He doesn't care about your story. He points to the grave. Power: 75. Style: clockwork ink. Subject: bronze centaur with spear. Mood: machine-judgment.

cards.power: Eternal Stare. Paralyzes one character for 2 turns.
cards.lore: Top Draw of the silent era. Her promotion is dead, but she's still booking. Power: 80. Style: spectral ink. Subject: bandaged cat-queen on throne, green glow. Mood: undead allure.

cards.power: The Script. Reveals the next 3 cards in the deck.
cards.lore: Read the spoilers. Leave the city. Power: Artifact. Style: relic ink. Subject: stacked stone tablets with runes. Mood: forbidden script.

cards.power: Dead Crowd. No 'Pop' bonuses can be earned here.
cards.lore: They believed the story so much they became the set. Power: Field hazard. Style: stone-grey ink. Subject: frozen merchants in dusty bazaar. Mood: silent stage.

cards.power: The Prison. Traps a Genie card permanently in discard.
cards.lore: The original Promoter's trap. Even the big guys can't break this contract. Power: Artifact. Style: relic ink. Subject: corked bottle with wax seal, swirling smoke. Mood: bound power.

cards.power: Sonic Attack. Discards opponent's hand.
cards.lore: Loudmouth on the mic. Screaming promos for centuries. Power: Effect. Style: fire ink. Subject: twin-mouthed flame demon screaming. Mood: burning howl.

cards.power: Suicide Dive. Rolling a 1 causes self-destruction.
cards.lore: Don't look down. The height is a work, the fall is a shoot. Power: Ring Out. Style: ink-wash. Subject: leaning tower with falling figures. Mood: vertiginous fate.

cards.power: Aerial Assault. Bypasses 'Guard' cards.
cards.lore: Mastered the screws. You can't hit what you can't reach. Power: 70. Style: pulp ink. Subject: hawk-prince in cape mid-flight. Mood: untouchable showman.

cards.power: Tech Gimmick. Grants +50 Power and 'Flying'.
cards.lore: A mechanical work that looks like magic. Power: Mount. Style: clockwork ink. Subject: brass-saddled black horse with cogs. Mood: wonder-machine.

cards.power: Sabotage. Removes 'Flying' from opponent; causes crash.
cards.lore: Heel Inventor. He built the trap. You're just a kid in his saddle. Power: 55. Style: ink-wash. Subject: crow-engineer with blueprint scroll. Mood: malicious genius.

cards.power: Insanity Promo. Cannot be 'Married' (captured) by Heels.
cards.lore: Not crazy; just cutting the best promo of her life to avoid the stable. Power: 45. Style: feral ink. Subject: tigress-princess mid-roar in robes. Mood: defiant performance.

cards.power: The Wind of Fate. Cannot return to board if 'Calendar' is in play.
cards.lore: One night of wind, ten years of shame. A footnote in a mother's calendar. Power: 15. Style: shameful ink. Subject: skunk in robes hiding face. Mood: eternal embarrassment.

cards.power: Cheap Heat. Generates heat for the opponent; exiles Abu Hasan.
cards.lore: A biological accident is as damaging as a steel chair. Power: Status Effect. Style: cartoon ink. Subject: grinning green smog cloud. Mood: weaponized bodily comedy.

cards.power: The Ref Bump. When played, triggers 'Blame Game'.
cards.lore: The prop body. Tag! You're the killer. Power: 0. Style: macabre ink. Subject: opossum jester slumped in red. Mood: scapegoat corpse.

cards.power: Choking Hazard. Causes temporary 'Death' state.
cards.lore: A tiny foreign object. The ultimate No-Sell. Power: Weapon. Style: ink-cross-section. Subject: fish skeleton inside red throat. Mood: tiny catastrophe.

cards.power: Panic Turn. Transfers 'Guilt Token' to adjacent card.
cards.lore: Tripped in the dark. This isn't medical school; it's a crime scene. Power: 40. Style: noir ink. Subject: rat-doctor with stethoscope over body. Mood: panicked alibi.

cards.power: Stitching the Squash. Returns destroyed card as 'Zombie'.
cards.lore: Just wanted to fix the body so no one would notice. Power: 30. Style: noir ink. Subject: spider-tailor stitching corpse. Mood: macabre seamstress.

cards.power: Drunken Brawl. Attacks blindly.
cards.lore: Thought the corpse was a burglar. Worked himself into a shoot. Power: 35. Style: drunken ink. Subject: boar-steward swinging mallet at sack. Mood: chaotic alibi.

cards.power: Filibuster. Delays execution phase by talking forever.
cards.lore: The Talker. He saves the day by annoying everyone to death. Power: 25. Style: cartoon ink. Subject: parrot-barber mid-rant in chair. Mood: garrulous siege.

cards.power: Disguised Audit. Look at opponent's hand; discard one Heel card.
cards.lore: THE COMMISSIONER. He wanders the streets to catch you breaking rules. Power: 95. Style: regal ink. Subject: lion in beggar cloak with staff. Mood: hidden authority.

cards.power: The Enforcer. Destroys 'Corruption' cards.
cards.lore: THE GRAND VIZIER. He cleans up the Caliph's mess. Power: 85. Style: noir ink. Subject: stork-vizier with quill scroll. Mood: stoic fixer.

cards.power: Witty Verse. Boosts Face character power by +30.
cards.lore: THE PROMO WRITER. His segments are legendary, if he shows up sober. Power: 60. Style: tipsy ink. Subject: baboon-bard with wine cup and scrolls. Mood: louche genius.

cards.power: The Bell. Ends the match instantly if King orders it.
cards.lore: When he steps in, the storyline ends. Power: Finisher. Style: brutal ink. Subject: bear-executioner with scimitar across chest. Mood: terminal authority.

cards.power: Dead Wait. Transforms into 'Mutilated Body' after 3 turns.
cards.lore: Don't open it. The smell isn't gold; it's a botched finish. Power: 0. Style: noir ink. Subject: half-submerged chest in dark water. Mood: ominous reveal.

cards.power: Clue Gimmick. Protects Vizier from execution.
cards.lore: One apple for a life. A fair trade in a nonsensical world. Power: 20. Style: noir still-life. Subject: half-bitten apple on rain-stained ground. Mood: damp clue.

cards.power: Blinded Rage. Attacks nearest character (friend or foe).
cards.lore: Saw the apple, saw red. No one gets a happy ending. Power: 65. Style: red-eyed ink. Subject: ram-husband snorting steam. Mood: jealous fury.

cards.power: Scapegoat. Takes damage intended for another card.
cards.lore: Took the apple, took the heat. Power: 10. Style: melancholy ink. Subject: goat with apple in mouth, head bowed. Mood: knowing martyr.

cards.power: The Sell. You must 'Sell' Bizarro effects or lose the game.
cards.lore: The currency of the realm. Keep the marks believing. Power: Meter. Style: gauge ink. Subject: brass disbelief-meter pegged in red. Mood: pressure-system.

cards.power: Pull Strings. Steals opponent of Title/Artifact without a clean finish.
cards.lore: Massive Heat. Unfair reset. The boss wins. Power: Riser! Style: ringside ink. Subject: ref grabbing belt while wrestler protests. Mood: betrayed shock.

cards.power: To Be Continued... Stops a 'Death' blow; match resumes next night.
cards.lore: The only defense against the Executioner. Power: Defense. Style: pulp ink. Subject: fox dangling from clock-hand over cliff. Mood: serial-thriller pause.

cards.power: True Face. Prevents identity reveals.
cards.lore: To lose the mask is to lose your soul. Keep it on. Power: Equipment. Style: lucha ink. Subject: jewel-colored mask with eye-holes. Mood: sacred identity.
